description: A tooth the size of a fingernail, root and all. Something small lost it, and something small missed it.
lore: Four gold, which is the least the trade pays for anything, and there is one at nearly every fire, kept in a knot of cloth by somebody who cannot tell you what it came off. There was a man on [[characters/7a779de1|Wendell]]'s stretch of the east road who asked everyone he met the same question: do hedgehogs have milk teeth. He would produce the tooth, hold it out flat on his palm, and wait. He had had it a great deal longer than he had had the reason for it. People said yes, mostly — a [[monsters/hedgehog|Quillkin]] sheds them and they are all over the low country — and he would put it away satisfied and ask again the next season, because the asking was the part he could still lose.
gm_notes: Thinning at the smallest scale: the detail goes first, then the reason, then the question. What the tooth actually came off is never settled and should not be.
